name: hidx_link_r5y-r5y-COMMIT
purpose: HIDX top-k link r5y (FAM-HBM-C/C-IDX 10-21): r5x RTL+spine unchanged; parallel fallback: 650x518.4 outline (closer to d4g 650x500 slot), bank stacks at 108-um pitch (30.6-um channels, >=21.6 r3 minimum), fill 37.6% without waiver

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_idx_topk_link_static_p #(.SAFE(2)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/index/ot_hbm_idx_topk_link_static_p.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: link_pipe_exact
bench.pass_regex: IDX_LINK_PIPE_TOTAL MUT0 records3072 miter1954 errors0 fillsff maxpack71 first_tx ref187 dut192 fault ref1954 dut1959

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hidx_link_r5y/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hidx_link_r5y/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hidx_link_r5y --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hbm_idx_topk_link_static_p --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: FAM-HBM-C/C-IDX 10-21 r5y: r5x gate (GRT0, spread 44.6, setup +5.4, M3 21.6% used) failed only fill 34.7%; fallback compacts bank pitch 129.6->108 um and outline height 561.6->518.4 (N-face margin 73 um kept); RTL, pins, spine unchanged
